author: SuperBrainXBRO
quote: Rating: 0/10 – A Masterpiece of DisappointmentI went into this game expecting an adventure and came out questioning my entire existence. I have seen microwaves with better character development. The graphics look like someone tried to remake a masterpiece using a potato and a dying **** controls feel like they were designed by someone who has never touched a controller. Link moves like he has 47 unpaid taxes and a broken spine. Even Navi telling me "HEY! LISTEN!" for the 500th time was somehow the highlight of my **** story? A green dude runs around collecting things because apparently nobody in Hyrule has heard of doing their own job.I would rather fight Ganondorf with a wet baguette than play this again.Nintendo should personally apologize to my eyes, my brain, and the electricity bill I wasted playing this.0/10. Would rather get trapped in the Water Temple for eternity.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: SuperBrainXBRO
quote: Rating: 10/10 – The Greatest Creation of HumanityGTA 6 is not a video game. It is a experience. I haven't even played it yet and I'm already emotionally attached to every NPC in Vice **** graphics are so realistic that I accidentally tried to pay taxes while watching the trailer. The attention to detail is absolutely insane. You can probably see individual thoughts forming inside NPCs' heads.Rockstar didn't develop a game. They developed a second life, and honestly, I might prefer it over my first **** story? Probably better than 99% of Hollywood movies. The characters? Absolute legends. The world? So alive that I wouldn't be surprised if my real-life neighbors started appearing as random NPCs.I would sell my furniture, my car, and possibly my left kidney to experience this masterpiece.10/10. GOTY, GOTD, GOTC (Game of the Century).Rockstar, take my money. Take my house. Take my future children. Just give me GTA 6
